an8.34:1.1: 34 aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgate bhikkhave khette bījaṃ vuttaṃ namahapphalaṃ hoti namahassādaṃ naphātiseyyanti.
an8.34:1.3: idha bhikkhave khettaṃ unnamininnāmi ca hoti pāsāṇasakkharillañca hoti ūsarañca hoti na ca gambhīrasitaṃ hoti na āyasampannaṃ hoti na apāyasampannaṃ hoti na mātikāsampannaṃ hoti na mariyādasampannaṃ hoti
an8.34:1.4: evaṃ aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgate bhikkhave khette bījaṃ vuttaṃ namahapphalaṃ hoti namahassādaṃ naphātiseyyanti. evameva
an8.34:2.1: kho bhikkhave aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgatesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu dānaṃ dinnaṃ namahapphalaṃ hoti namahānisaṃsaṃ namahājutikaṃ namahāvipphāraṃ.
an8.34:2.3: idha bhikkhave samaṇabrāhmaṇā micchādiṭṭhikā honti micchāsaṅkappā micchāvācā micchākammantā micchāājīvā micchāvāyāmā micchāsatino micchāsamādhino
an8.34:2.4: evaṃ aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgatesu bhikkhave samaṇabrāhmaṇesu dānaṃ dinnaṃ namahapphalaṃ hoti namahānisaṃsaṃ namahājutikaṃ namahāvipphāraṃ.
an8.34:3.1: aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgate ca bhikkhave khette bījaṃ vuttaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahassādaṃ phātiseyyanti.
an8.34:3.3: idha bhikkhave khettaṃ anunnamininnāmi ca hoti apāsāṇasakkharillañca hoti anūsarañca hoti gambhīrasitaṃ hoti āyasampannaṃ hoti apāyasampannaṃ hoti mātikāsampannaṃ hoti mariyādasampannaṃ hoti
an8.34:3.4: evaṃ aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgate bhikkhave khette bījaṃ vuttaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahassādaṃ phātiseyyanti.
an8.34:4.1: evameva kho bhikkhave aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgatesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsaṃ mahājutikaṃ mahāvipphāraṃ.
an8.34:4.3: idha bhikkhave samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammādiṭṭhikā honti sammāsaṅkappā sammāvācā sammākammantā sammāājīvā sammāvāyāmā sammāsatino sammāsamādhino
an8.34:4.4: evaṃ aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgatesu bhikkhave samaṇabrāhmaṇesu dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti mahānisaṃsaṃ mahājutikaṃ mahāvipphāranti.
